candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Base text correct. Invents furigana not printed: 食(た), 多(おお), 聞(き). Omits printed furigana: 思(おも) twice, 好(す), 次(つぎ) in the last checkbox, and 質問(しつもん) in three places (second one in '2つのことを質問しない' and both in the final example). Layout and indented examples are fine.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Base text correct and every printed furigana is present. But it adds readings to nearly every kanji where the page has none: 日本(にほん), 日本人(にほんじん), 多(おお), 人(ひと), 中(なか), 高(たか), 店(みせ), 言(い), 長(なが), 名前(なまえ), 買(か), 見(み), 聞(き), 後(あと), 食(た), and 次(つぎ) in '次のような'. Bold 72 matches the page; list structure is good.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Furigana matches the page essentially exactly: 食べ物(もの) only, 思(おも), 好(す), 聞き方(かた), 次(つぎ) only in the last item, 例(れい) on each example. No invented readings. Clean list structure with checkboxes; footer included.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: Same over-annotation as B: adds unprinted furigana throughout, including 日本(にほん), 人(ひと), 多(おお), 高(たか), 中(なか), 店(みせ), 言(い), 長(なが), 名前(なまえ), 買(か), 見(み), 聞(き), 後(あと), and 次(つぎ) in the intro line. Base text is correct and complete; formatting is simple and adequate.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Largely faithful furigana with no invented readings. Errors: 用意(よウい) has a stray katakana ウ; 例(れい) furigana is omitted on all four example lines. Examples are not indented; タスク is bold rather than a heading. Otherwise matches the page.

rationale: All five get the base text right, so the ranking turns on furigana fidelity. C reproduces exactly the readings printed on the page, with none added or dropped. E is nearly as faithful but has the よウい typo and drops 例(れい) four times. A mixes a few invented readings with several omissions. B and D include every printed reading but invent readings for dozens of kanji that have none on the page, which misrepresents the source; they are nearly identical, and B edges ahead only for its bold page number and clearer list structure.
